name: Marketing agency hero: dark full-bleed with blurred gradient blobs that drift toward the cursor
notes: No photo — three blurred radial-gradient circles (mix-blend-mode:screen) are the whole background. Inline script listens for pointermove on the section, lerps each blob's translate3d toward the cursor at its own 'data-depth' speed (0.06 easing factor per frame via requestAnimationFrame) so the blobs trail with a soft parallax lag rather than snapping to the pointer; on pointerleave they drift back to center. Each blob also runs its own independent CSS scale-pulse keyframe so it's never fully static even with the mouse away, but the JS transform and the CSS pulse are on separate nested elements (.blob for JS translate, .blob-core for the CSS animation) specifically so they don't stomp the same transform property. Script self-skips entirely under prefers-reduced-motion (checked once on load) and the CSS also kills the pulse keyframes for that case — touch devices simply get the idle pulse with blobs centered, which still looks intentional. A light grain overlay (radial-gradient dot pattern) keeps the blur from looking like a cheap Photoshop glow.
